title: One line of runs/<story>/journal.jsonl — written by hooks (SubagentStart/Stop, PostToolUse) and phase scripts; the only source of truth for resume across sessions

event.description: DECISION = a single decision closed by decide.js (never a gate); GATE_ANSWER = a gate closed by decide.js --gate

migration_sha.description: GATE_OPEN / GATE_ANSWER for G2b: content hash of the story's migrations (migration-check.js); an answer counts only for the report with the same hash

owner_answer.description: OWNER_ANSWER: copied verbatim from PostToolUse(AskUserQuestion).tool_response or UserPromptSubmit
